summary: Iteration 2: PIN auth, route protection and student self-registration (pending -> approve/reject) tested end-to-end via public URL. Backend 48/49 pytest pass (regression suite updated to log in first). The only failure: the brute-force limiter does NOT reliably return 429 after 5 wrong PINs because it keys on request.client.host, which is the k8s ingress proxy IP (10.11.1.72 / 10.11.1.73 alternate) instead of the real client. Frontend: all requested flows pass on a 375x667 mobile viewport (bienvenida -> inscripcion with validation/disabled submit -> success; acceso wrong PIN error -> tabs; pending banner -> solicitudes; approve 10 / two-tap reject; approved student with medkit icon + info modal showing phone/email/health notes; attendance regression; logout -> bienvenida; reload/deep links without token -> bienvenida). No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView issues detected. NOTE: the seed students María García and Juan Pérez were NOT in the DB when I checked (students collection was empty apart from my TEST_ data). My tests only delete the ids they create. The backend log shows the seed POSTs (127.0.0.1, lines 13-14) and iteration-1 DELETEs before this iteration started.

critical.issue: The rate limiter keys on request.client.host (server.py:86-87), which is the ingress proxy IP, not the user. (a) Six wrong PINs in a row all returned 401 because the requests alternated between proxies 10.11.1.72 and .73, so each proxy has its own counter and the limit is about 5 x number of proxies. (b) Worse: one person's failed attempts lock out EVERYONE behind that proxy, including the monitor (we saw this: after the lockout, a correct PIN got 429). Fix: take the client IP from the first X-Forwarded-For entry, falling back to client.host, or add a global failure counter. The counter is also in-memory, so it resets on restart and is not shared across workers.

minor.issue: Public endpoint with no rate limit or captcha, so anyone can spam pending registrations.
Not atomic: the registration is marked approved before the student is inserted. If insert_one fails, the registration is lost (no rollback).
The seed students María García and Juan Pérez are missing from test_database.students. The main agent should re-seed them if they are expected.

ui_bugs.issue: q.isError is not handled. If GET /registrations fails (e.g. a non-401 error), the screen shows 'No hay inscripciones pendientes' instead of an error. On an approve/reject error (e.g. 404, already handled on another device) the list is not refreshed, so the stale card stays.

issues: The student name is truncated heavily ('TEST_UI …') at 375px because the 'Registrar Asistencia' button takes about half the row width. Longer Spanish names will be cut. Consider stacking the button under the name or using a shorter label.
The toast uses white text on success #34C759, about 2.2:1 contrast, below WCAG AA. Use brandPrimary #248A3D or dark text.
The approve-5/approve-10 buttons are 40px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target.

action_items: Fix the login rate limiter key: use the first IP in X-Forwarded-For (fallback request.client.host) so the lockout is per real client and does not lock out the monitor via the shared ingress IP.
Re-seed the María García and Juan Pérez students if they are expected (the DB currently has no students).
Handle the error state in solicitudes.tsx (q.isError) and refresh the list on approve/reject errors.
Improve the toast contrast and stop student names from truncating in the Alumnos row. Make the approve buttons at least 44px tall.
(tabs)/index.tsx is 727 lines (>700): split the modals (AddStudentModal, RenewBonoModal, info/delete modals) into separate components.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:86 _client_key uses the proxy IP, so brute-force protection is ineffective and enables a lockout DoS (see backend critical).

The tabs screens have no auth guard. They rely on a 401 -> clearToken -> router.replace('/bienvenida') in api.ts. It works (verified deep links to /solicitudes and /historial redirect), but the protected UI briefly mounts first.
The client email regex /\S+@\S+\.\S+/ is looser than Pydantic EmailStr. Edge cases get a generic 'Revisa los datos' 422 message (acceptable).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_asistencia_api.py (session fixture now logs in with the PIN)
seed_data_creation: Created the TEST_Reg_* registrations/students (pytest) and TEST_UI Alumna / TEST_UI Rechazo (UI). All deleted by their ids afterwards. Lucía Ruiz (pending) was left untouched. The backend was restarted to clear the in-memory login limiter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0 (xdist is enabled in pytest.ini, and parallel runs collide with the lockout test). test_zz_lockout_429 must run last, and you must run 'sudo supervisorctl restart backend' afterwards. The ingress uses two proxy IPs (10.11.1.72/.73), so per-IP lockout is split across them. The registrations POST returns only {ok,name}, so look up the id via GET /registrations by unique name. The rejected/approved registrations can only be cleaned up via Mongo (there is no delete API).
rca_of_issue: Lockout: uvicorn runs behind the k8s ingress, so request.client.host = the ingress pod IP. The backend log shows the login requests alternating between 10.11.1.72 and 10.11.1.73. Reproduce: send 6 sequential wrong PINs through the public URL and you get [401 x6]. With parallel traffic, one proxy reaches 5 failures and then blocks every user (including a correct PIN) for 15 minutes.
